articles.summary: Chandler, Arizona, July 28, 2026: Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) today announced financial results for the second quarter of 2026.
articles.title: Rogers Corporation Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: Chandler, Arizona, July 16, 2026: Rogers Corporation today released its 2026 Sustainability Report, outlining Rogers’ approach to managing environmental impacts, supporting employees, maintaining strong governance practices, and developing advanced materials that help customers improve efficiency and enable next-generation technologies.
articles.title: Rogers Corporation Releases Its 2026 Sustainability Report

articles.summary: Chandler, Arizona, July 14, 2026: Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) (“Rogers”) plans to announce second quarter 2026 results on July 28, 2026 after market close, which will be followed by a conference call at 5:00 pm ET.
articles.title: Rogers Corporation Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call for July 28
